metadata.verificationMethod: Reproduce approval-rate estimates from the frozen loan-application records and compare them across independently chosen market, product, and applicant groupings.

tasks.name: Where Mortgage Applications Succeed
tasks.content: Where are homebuyers most likely to have their mortgage applications approved?

metadata.verificationMethod: Recompute denial-reason frequencies and adjusted associations, then test whether the ordering survives alternative treatments of missing, multiple, and inapplicable reasons.

tasks.name: Why Mortgage Applications Are Denied
tasks.content: What seems to distinguish applications that are denied from those that move forward?

metadata.verificationMethod: Have mortgage-lending experts score the lender assessment against an evidence rubric, inspect counterexamples, and compare conclusions under competing definitions of community service.

tasks.name: Lenders Serving Their Communities
tasks.content: Which lenders appear to serve their local communities particularly well?

metadata.verificationMethod: Independently reconstruct the comparison cohorts and adjusted models, audit overlap and missingness, and verify that reported gaps are robust to reasonable product and geography definitions.

tasks.name: Comparable Applicants and Unequal Outcomes
tasks.content: Do similarly situated applicants receive meaningfully different mortgage outcomes?

metadata.verificationMethod: Ask independent domain reviewers to assess the underserved-market ranking, proxy choices, alternative explanations, and actionability; test whether recommendations persist under different normative priorities.

tasks.name: Finding Underserved Mortgage Markets
tasks.content: Which communities seem underserved by the mortgage market, and what might be going wrong?

metadata.verificationMethod: Reproduce rating summaries from linked title and ratings records and check whether conclusions survive vote thresholds, title-type splits, and weighted versus unweighted estimates.

tasks.name: Titles Audiences Rate Highly
tasks.content: What kinds of titles tend to receive higher audience ratings?

metadata.verificationMethod: Rebuild episode and season trajectories, audit missing episodes and vote coverage, and compare results under several pre-registered definitions of declining enthusiasm.

tasks.name: When Series Lose Momentum
tasks.content: When does a television series seem to lose its audience's enthusiasm?

metadata.verificationMethod: Independently count regional and language aliases, sample-check title linkage, and test rankings under alternative definitions of cross-market reach and minimum title prominence.

tasks.name: Stories That Cross Borders
tasks.content: Which titles seem to travel especially well across languages and regions?

metadata.verificationMethod: Have film-domain reviewers judge the proposed breakthrough narratives against full career timelines, rejected alternatives, and counterexamples; measure agreement across reviewers.

tasks.name: Recognizing a Career Breakthrough
tasks.content: What does a real career breakthrough look like for people working in film and television?

metadata.verificationMethod: Audit the collaboration graph and then ask independent experts to assess whether the chosen influence concept, role scope, and case interpretations are defensible under competing network definitions.

tasks.name: Influential Creative Collaborators
tasks.content: Who seems unusually influential in shaping creative collaboration networks?

metadata.verificationMethod: Recompute tip rates for eligible trip and payment types, audit zero and missing tips, and compare patterns across time, route, distance, and fare bands.

tasks.name: When Riders Tip More

metadata.verificationMethod: Recreate route-level time and price baselines, validate zone joins and trip filters, and confirm flagged routes under robust outlier definitions and comparable trip conditions.

tasks.name: Unexpectedly Slow or Expensive Routes
tasks.content: Which trips or routes are slower or more expensive than a rider might reasonably expect?

metadata.verificationMethod: Independently rerun temporal, geographic, and arithmetic anomaly rules, manually inspect stratified samples, and report precision estimates for each anomaly class.

tasks.name: Suspicious Trip Records
tasks.content: Which trip records look suspicious, and what kinds of data problems might they reveal?

metadata.verificationMethod: Have transportation experts review the inferred supply-demand gaps, compare plausible proxy definitions, inspect contradictory zones and hours, and judge whether proposed interpretations exceed the available evidence.

tasks.name: Where Ride Availability Falls Short
tasks.content: Where and when does ride availability seem poorly matched to what travelers need?

metadata.verificationMethod: Reproduce late-delivery rates after auditing order status, timestamp consistency, missing delivery dates, and the definition of lateness; sample-check extreme cases.

tasks.name: Orders That Arrive Late
tasks.content: Which kinds of orders are most likely to arrive later than promised?

metadata.verificationMethod: Rebuild order-level features without join inflation, reproduce review comparisons, and check stability across product, seller, geography, price, and delivery-time controls.

tasks.name: What Leads to Better Reviews
tasks.content: When do customers tend to leave better reviews?

metadata.verificationMethod: Independently reconcile item prices, freight, payments, and order multiplicity, then verify high-burden segments under alternative denominators and treatment of multi-item orders.

tasks.name: Why Shipping Feels Expensive
tasks.content: For which purchases does shipping become unusually expensive relative to what is being bought?

metadata.verificationMethod: Have marketplace-operations reviewers assess the seller scorecard, inspect borderline sellers, and test whether conclusions persist across reasonable metric weights, minimum-volume rules, and uncertainty adjustments.

tasks.name: Sellers Customers Can Rely On
tasks.content: Which sellers seem to provide consistently strong service?

metadata.verificationMethod: Use independent expert scoring of the opportunity rationale, rejected alternatives, operational constraints, proxy validity, and sensitivity to competing growth priorities.

tasks.name: Promising Marketplace Expansion
tasks.content: Where might the marketplace have its most promising room to expand?

metadata.verificationMethod: Reconstruct statement totals from numeric facts and presentation relationships, check units and contexts, and compare every flagged inconsistency with the relevant calculation relationships.

tasks.name: Companies Improving Profitability
tasks.content: Which companies appear to be improving their profitability, and which are moving the other way?

metadata.verificationMethod: Have financial analysts code a sample of narrative disclosures, review the theme synthesis and omitted risks, and measure whether independent reviewers reach similar interpretations.

tasks.content: What risks and uncertainties are companies emphasizing in their disclosures?

metadata.verificationMethod: Audit taxonomy mappings, units, periods, dimensions, custom tags, and company selection; reproduce comparability scores and test them against expert-reviewed fact pairs.

tasks.content: How comparable are the revenue figures that different companies report?
